reference.note: matched (frozen-prior) onset both classes; NOT the same dataset/n as the primary leaderboard -- freshly generated for this audit at smaller n, so compare within-audit, not to the frozen A*/XGBoost numbers directly

pump1_h1_partial.interpretation: The naive (fixed-onset) model reaches near its OWN legitimate confounded-distribution Bayes ceiling in-distribution (onset alone is a near-perfect giveaway when it's deterministic per class), then collapses toward the reference-level accuracy once evaluated on a controlled test set where onset no longer reveals the class. The naive in-distribution number must not be compared with the matched-onset A* because it belongs to a different, confounded distribution with its own recomputed ceiling.
